title.en: An Act Creating a Board to Have Charge of the Selection and Approval of the Textbooks to Be Used By the Colleges and Schools of the Government, and for Other

text.en:
A board is hereby created which shall be known as the Board on Textbooks and shall have
charge of the selection and approval of the textbooks to be used in all colleges and schools of the Government.

It shall also be the duty of the Board to investigate the curriculum of the colleges and schools of
the Government and make recommendations to the Secretary of Public Instruction.
It shall further be the duty of the Board to revise the textbooks on history and civics used in the private
colleges and schools recognized by the Government, for adoption in the same by the Secretary of Public
Instruction.

The Board on Textbooks created by this Act shall have power to appoint such technical
employees as may be necessary to advise it, and, subject to the approval of the Council of State, to fix their
compensation.
All acts and legal provisions inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 19, 1921.
